Jonas / Laura — ran rough economics with capacity team. Proposal below (high level bullets you can pass along):

- Commitment & price-hold: 12-month price hold on their current per-token rate contingent on a 20% committed capacity increase (measured as average monthly committed GPU-hours). We can lock the price for 12 months from the renewal date.
- Uplift phasing: Accept staged uplift (50% at day 0, remaining 50% ramped evenly over 90 days). We'll require a short 'ramp schedule' appendix to the SOW to track targets.
- One-time credit: Offer a $35k migration/validation credit applied as invoice credit over first 2 months post-renewal OR optionally as a 60-day usage credit — client can choose. This covers test runs, evals, and CI validation.
- Safeguards: If monthly usage exceeds committed capacity by >30% for more than 2 consecutive months, we treat excess as on-demand usage at standard list rate (protects us during unexpected spikes).
- Discounts: Given the uplift and price-hold, we don't need to increase % discounts; primary lever is the credit + firm commit.

Operational notes: serving/runtime team confirmed the staged ramp is fine provided the ramp schedule is honored — no infra change required but telemetry hooks are needed for quota enforcement.

If you're good, I can draft a brief one-page summary and a redline to the MSAG referencing the ramp appendix.

—Marcus
Senior Sales Operations

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear ask and the usage package. We've reviewed internally and can support the path you outlined. High level proposal for Novapulse: 

1) Commitment & price-hold: 12-month price hold on your current per-token rate in exchange for a 20% increase in committed monthly capacity (measured as average monthly committed GPU-hours). Price hold effective from renewal signature date.

2) Uplift phasing: We will do the staged uplift you requested — 50% applied at day 1, remaining 50% ramping evenly over 90 days. We'll include a short Ramp Schedule appendix to the SOW to capture target checkpoints and reporting cadence.

3) One-time credit: Redwood will provide a $35,000 migration/validation credit. You may elect to have this applied as: (a) invoice credit across months 1-2 post-renewal; or (b) a 60-day usage credit applied to your account. Let us know which you prefer.

4) Safeguards: If usage exceeds committed capacity by more than 30% for two consecutive months, overage will be billed at the standard on-demand list rate until the commit is rebalanced.
